the Higgs potential of the general NH DM can be studied using a geometric technique that does not require finding its minima explicitly, that the potential has a global minimum at the origin in the space of the gauge orbits, that the potential is invariant under an extended $Z_2 \times Z_2$ symmetry that is not present at the level of the Lagrangian, that there are three types of the potential, and that the global minimum is at the origin in all three types.

(i) the Higgs potential is bounded from below and (ii) the Higgs vacuum expectation values are constrained to lie in a subspace of the space of gauge-orbit directions.
